creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-3 section 13. Every pane's untrusted output is parsed by libghostty-vt inside one daemon process, so one crash in that parser ends every agent on the machine. Deferred from a_2XJ1fr2cu to live with the daemon, where recorded pane output first exists. Needs a decision first: cargo-fuzz wants nightly and rust-toolchain.toml pins stable, so either a nightly-only tier out of the gate, or a seeded mutation test that runs in the gate on stable. Also decide the optimize mode libghostty-vt is built with for the daemon (a Zig safety panic aborts the process; ReleaseFast removes checks, ReleaseSafe keeps them).
title: Fuzz muster-daemon's headless terminal with recorded pane output
